name: file-actions
title: File Actions
description: Alfred-style file & folder actions for the Finder selection: move, copy, trash, open, open with, open in terminal.
author: krishnayadav

commands.name: file-actions
commands.title: File Actions
commands.subtitle: Finder Selection
commands.description: Show actions for the files/folders selected in Finder. Assign a hotkey (e.g. ⌘O) in Raycast Settings → Extensions.

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal App
preferences.description: App used by "Open in Terminal" for folders (iTerm2, Terminal, Warp, Ghostty…). Falls back to Terminal if not installed.

preferences.name: confirmTrash
preferences.title: Trash
preferences.label: Ask for confirmation before moving to Bin
preferences.description: Show a confirmation dialog before moving items to the Bin

preferences.name: extraFolders
preferences.title: Pinned Folders
preferences.description: Comma-separated folders always shown as destinations (supports ~)
